items.title: Sponsors
Rev-dep
items.description: Dependency analysis and optimization toolkit for modern JavaScript and TypeScript projects. Trace imports, identify circular dependencies, find unused code, clean node modules.

items.title: callGraph
items.description: Statically generates a call graph image and displays it on screen.

items.title: ClassGraph
items.description: A classpath and module path scanner for querying or visualizing class metadata or class relatedness.

items.title: Putout
items.description: Pluggable and configurable code transformer with built-in eslint, babel plugins support for js, jsx typescript, flow, markdown, yaml and json.

items.title: OpenStaticAnalyzer
items.description: OpenStaticAnalyzer is a source code analyzer tool, which can perform deep static analysis of the source code of complex systems.

items.title: trivy
items.description: A Simple and Comprehensive Vulnerability Scanner for Containers and other Artifacts, Suitable for CI. Trivy detects vulnerabilities of OS packages (Alpine, RHEL, CentOS, etc.) and application dependencies (Bundler, Composer, npm, yarn, etc.). Checks containers and filesystems.

items.title: LangLint
items.description: Automated translation platform for code comments and docstrings across 20+ file types. Eliminates language barriers in international software collaboration. Supports 100+ language pairs with syntax protection. Integrates into CI/CD pipelines like Ruff. 10-20x faster with concurrent processing.

items.title: Depends
items.description: Analyses the comprehensive dependencies of code elements for Java, C/C++, Ruby.

items.title: sqlvet
items.description: Performs static analysis on raw SQL queries in your Go code base to surface potential runtime errors. It checks for SQL syntax error, identifies unsafe queries that could potentially lead to SQL injections makes sure column count matches value count in INSERT statements and validates table- and column names.

items.title: pfff
items.description: Facebook's tools for code analysis, visualizations, or style-preserving source transformation for many languages.

items.title: Bearer
items.description: Open-Source static code analysis tool to discover, filter and prioritize security risks and vulnerabilities leading to sensitive data exposures (PII, PHI, PD). Highly configurable and easily extensible, built for security and engineering teams.

items.title: ApplicationInspector
items.description: Creates reports of over 400 rule patterns for feature detection (e.g. the use of cryptography or version control in apps).

items.title: Skylos
items.description: Dead code detection, security scanning, secrets detection, and code quality analysis for Python, TypeScript, and Go. Framework-aware analysis with 98% recall. Includes CI/CD GitHub Action, VS Code extension, and MCP server for AI agent integration.

items.title: todocheck
items.description: Linter for integrating annotated TODOs with your issue trackers

items.title: BlockWatch
items.description: A language-agnostic linter that keeps code, documentation, and configuration in sync and enforces strict formatting and validation rules.

items.title: ESLint
items.description: An extensible linter for JS, following the ECMAScript standard.

items.title: TscanCode
items.description: A fast and accurate static analysis solution for C/C++, C#, Lua codes provided by Tencent. Using GPLv3 license.

items.title: ale
items.description: Asynchronous Lint Engine for Vim and NeoVim with support for many languages.

items.title: dotnet-format
items.description: A code formatter for .NET. Preferences will be read from an file, if present, otherwise a default set of preferences will be used. At this time dotnet-format is able to format C# and Visual Basic projects with a subset of supported options.

items.title: DevSkim
items.description: Regex-based static analysis tool for Visual Studio, VS Code, and Sublime Text - C/C++, C#, PHP, ASP, Python, Ruby, Java, and others.

items.title: Roslyn Analyzers
items.description: Roslyn-based implementation of FxCop analyzers.

items.title: WALA
items.description: Static analysis capabilities for Java bytecode and related languages and for JavaScript.

items.title: lizard
items.description: Lizard is an extensible Cyclomatic Complexity Analyzer for many programming languages including C/C++ (doesn't require all the header files or Java imports). It also does copy-paste detection (code clone detection/code duplicate detection) and many other forms of static code analysis. Counts lines of code without comments, CCN (cyclomatic complexity number), token count of functions, parameter count of functions.

items.title: oxc
items.description: The Oxidation Compiler is creating a suite of high-performance tools for the JavaScript / TypeScript language re-written in Rust.

items.title: codeql
items.description: Deep code analysis - semantic queries and dataflow for several languages with VSCode plugin support.

items.title: relint
items.description: A static file linter that allows you to write custom rules using regular expressions (RegEx).

items.title: ThreatMapper
items.description: Vulnerability Scanner and Risk Evaluation for containers, serverless and hosts at runtime. ThreatMapper generates runtime BOMs from dependencies and operating system packages, matches against multiple threat feeds, scans for unprotected secrets, and scores issues based on severity and risk-of-exploit.

items.title: PVS-Studio
items.description: copyright: — A (conditionally free for FOSS and individual developers) static analysis of C, C++, C# and Java code. For advertising purposes you can propose a large FOSS project for analysis by PVS employees. Supports CWE mapping, OWASP ASVS, MISRA, AUTOSAR and SEI CERT coding standards.

items.title: Pronto
items.description: Quick automated code review of your changes. Supports more than 40 runners for various languages, including Clang, Elixir, JavaScript, PHP, Ruby and more.

items.title: weggli
items.description: A fast and robust semantic search tool for C and C++ codebases. It is designed to help security researchers identify interesting functionality in large codebases.

items.title: Undebt
items.description: Language-independent tool for massive, automatic, programmable refactoring based on simple pattern definitions.

items.title: go-tools
items.description: A collection of tools and libraries for working with Go code, including linters and static analysis

items.title: Code Quality Checker Tools For PHP Projects
items.description: A collection of PHP linters in github collections

items.title: linters
items.description: An introduction to static code analysis

items.title: php-static-analysis-tools
items.description: A reviewed list of useful PHP static analysis tools

items.title: Clean code linters
items.description: A collection of linters in github collections
